text: The PR only removes a false claim from a LOGIC.md. The code and the corrected file already say what the fix says, so nothing needs to go in the knowledge files. Next I'll add the line to the PR body.

I wrote nothing to the knowledge files for #1841, so I made no commit.

**Why:** #1841 ("run.LOGIC.md drops the merge hold the code does not have") only deletes some sentences from `packages/agent-scheduler/src/run.LOGIC.md`. They claimed that when a run names a follow-up, its checkout goes under a merge hold, and the run fails if the hold can't be set. The code has no such hold. It only adds `HOLD_MERGE_LINE` to the agent's prompt, and the file already describes that under "The follow-up". The PR has no comments or reviews. With the code and the corrected file saying the same thing, a future agent has nothing to learn from `knowledge-base/`.

I added the line `Post-merge cleanup done.` to the end of #1841's body and left the rest as it was. The PR is still open and waiting to be merged.
